ei.title: Geospatial Technology That Brought Innovation to Historical Research

fullPassage: Mapping incorporates geography into historical storytelling in a direct and visually powerful way. Maps have played various and important roles in historical narratives. On the one hand, turning to digital mapping technologies is then continuous with this tradition. Historians can now analyze and make digital maps instead of the paper ones. On the other hand, geospatial technologies offer new ways of analyzing space, place, and territory. They do so by connecting digital maps to data behind the map which brings to historians the tools for spatial data exploration. Geospatial technologies also allow for overlaying (analyzing together visually or algorithmically) the specific spatial data layers with ease. In short, using geospatial technologies opens new research opportunities to historians who engage with place and space on the crest of the "spatial turn" and the digital revolution.

questions.passage: Mapping incorporates geography into historical storytelling in a (A)[direct / indirect] and visually powerful way. Maps have played various and important roles in historical narratives. On the one hand, turning to digital mapping technologies is then continuous with this tradition. Historians can now analyze and make (B)[digital / handwritten] maps instead of the paper ones. On the other hand, geospatial technologies offer new ways of analyzing space, place, and territory. They do so by connecting digital maps to data behind the map which brings to historians the tools for spatial data exploration. Geospatial technologies also allow for overlaying (analyzing together visually or algorithmically) the specific spatial data layers with (C)[ease / difficulty]. In short, using geospatial technologies opens new research opportunities to historians who engage with place and space on the crest of the "spatial turn" and the digital revolution.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ direct - digital - ease: 직접적이고 시각적으로 강력한 방식, 디지털 지도, 쉽게.
❌ ① indirect - digital - ease: 간접적은 직접과 반대.
❌ ② direct - handwritten - ease: 손으로 쓴은 digital과 반대.
❌ ③ direct - digital - difficulty: 어려움은 ease와 반대.
det.tip: direct(직접적) ↔ indirect. digital ↔ handwritten. ease(쉬움) ↔ difficulty(어려움).

det.analysis:
✅ ② incorporates - continuous - opens: 지리를 '통합', 전통과 '연속적', 새 기회를 '열다'.

❌ ③ incorporates - discontinuous - opens: 불연속은 연속과 반대.
❌ ④ incorporates - continuous - closes: 닫다는 열다와 반대.

✅ ① excludes: 원문은 incorporates(통합하다). 지리를 '배제한다'는 역사적 스토리텔링에 지리를 포함시킨다는 맥락과 정반대.

❌ ③ offer: 새 방법을 '제공한다' — 원문 그대로.
